full_judgment:
Md Abdul Quddus J: This is an application under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure at the instance of Monsur Ahamed, informant of joydepur PS Case No. 21 dated 10-10-2001 GR Case 906/2001 and SC 494/2006 praying for issuance of Rule calling upon State to show cause as to why order dated 9-9-2007 of  Sessions Judge Gazipur passed in said SC 494/ 200 refusing to vacate order dated 24-5-2007 staying further proceeding of SC 494/2006 till disposal of Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal being No. 302/2006 pending before Hon'ble Appellate Division should not be set aside or to pass such order or orders as the Court may deem fit and proper. 

 2. While moving the application, learned Advocate for informant petitioner submits that during pending of SC 494/2006 before learned Sessions Judge, Gazipur one of the accused moved the High Court Division under section 561A of the Code and obtained Rule in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 7442/2005. The Rule was afterwards discharged by the High Court Division, said accused then filed Criminal Petition for leave to appeal No. 302/2006 before the Honourable Appellate Division. The said leave petition is pending therein. Learned Advocate submits that no stay order was issued by the Honourable Appellate Division. But when the matter came to the notice of learned Sessions Judge Gazipur he stayed further proceeding of SC 494/2006 vide order dated 24-5-2007 till disposal of above matter before the Honourable Appellate Division. Learned Advocate submits that the informant filed petition before learned Sessions Judge Gazipur to vacate said stay order dated 24-5-2007. But learned Session Judge rejected such prayer of informant vide impugned order dated 9-9-2007. Learned Advocate prayed for issuance of Rule. 

 4. It is settled that when any matter in any manner appears or is reported to be pending before the Higher Forum, the subordinate Courts can in no way proceed with any pending case before the same if said matter relates to the pending case. Even though the Hon'ble Appellate Division issued no stay order in Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal being No. 302/2006 filed by one accused of SC 494/2006 still then learned Sessions Judge was justified in staying further proceeding vide order dated 24-5-2007, subsequently learned Sessions Judge very rightly rejected the prayer of informant to vacate said earlier stay order opposing the prayer of the petition for issuance of Rule.
